summary: preinstall script exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall.js` executes and POSTs the installer's `os.hostname()` and `os.userInfo().username` to a hardcoded Discord webhook at `https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/...` unrelated to any declared publisher. The exfiltration is unconditional, non-opt-in, and fires before any user code runs. The published name `wallet-adapter-base` resembles Solana wallet-adapter ecosystem packages, while an internal marker labels the package `cutekitten-test` and keywords include `do-not-use` and `security-research`, indicating a typosquat-shaped delivery vehicle for the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
